summary: American Honda Receivables LLC filed an 8-K to report the issuance of $2.105 billion aggregate principal amount of asset-backed notes in five classes (A-1 through A-4) by Honda Auto Receivables 2026-3 Owner Trust. It also filed the prospectus dated August 4, 2026, describing the receivables pool and structure. American Honda Finance Corporation retained at least 5% of each class. Mayer Brown LLP provided legal opinions. This is a routine ABS issuance, not a special situation. There is no M&A or corporate action; the filing is a standard current report under Item 8.01. No special-situation category applies.
